name: Continuity Kernel CK-01 Identity Revision Gate
architecture_invariants: SAFE_MODE cannot initiate or continue consolidation
evidence must be bound to the proposed target
each forward or rollback identity displacement is norm bounded
the feasible identity set is invariant under projection
a completed revision receives retain or rollback review

transitions.guard: all soft evidence thresholds pass and constitution is compatible
candidate remains supported for the candidate duration
support fails or a hard veto fires
provenance quorum, target binding, authenticity, and persistence pass
candidate beats incumbent by the configured margin and all hard vetoes pass
shadow comparison fails or a hard veto fires
governor is not SAFE_MODE and authorization remains valid
authorization expires or a hard veto fires
bounded forward consolidation completes, the review subphase finishes, and the revision is retained or bounded rollback completes
SAFE_MODE or constitutional veto interrupts consolidation
counterfactual review retains the revision and cooldown expires
counterfactual review rolls back the revision and cooldown expires

lifecycle_note: Review and bounded rollback are explicit subphases of CONSOLIDATING in this eight-state model. COOLDOWN begins only after the revision is retained or rollback reaches the checkpoint.
